reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed: /health is an actively registered, reachable route (Gate 1 skipped — missing-validation finding); BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json contains no trust_assumptions block and the entry point is an unauthenticated external HTTP request (Gate 2 not applicable); src/index.ts is explicitly in-scope (Gate 3 not triggered). An attacker can trigger this via the public HTTP port (port 3000) by sending unauthenticated GET /health requests, causing disclosure of the Discord guild ID and bot user tag plus repeated consumption of the bot's Discord API rate-limit quota via live client.guilds.fetch() calls on every invocation.
